notes.title: Winter Games Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The Winter Games Tournament is complete, with a long list of fun mini-games made by the community.  This tournament saw the release of many new and innovative types of games you want to be sure to try.

[b]Lone Water: Prologue[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-74719900-1484583755_thumb.jpg[/img]
Lone Water tell a history about a flooded world.  You are a lone survivor in this world and you must find clues to figure out why the world is now all flooded with water.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=815172579

[b]On the Road Again[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-34432300-1484583848_thumb.jpg[/img]
On the road again is a little racing game where a track is randomly generated
with a given seed. You either use a car or a ball to complete levels. Compete with others as you can see their highscores via the Steam leaderboards.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=821020417

[b]Snowmageddon[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-97076100-1484583903_thumb.jpg[/img]
Build your own base and defend it against evil snowmen!
This game was built just for fun, and is still a little buggy. It has 11 waves of snowmen, and 13 different structures you can build. The controls and instructions are in the game. Feel free to comment if you find anything wrong, or one of those dreaded misspelled words.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=823633686

[b]The Van[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-79202400-1484583953_thumb.jpg[/img]
Just another slow day at the biotech firm. You work at the main research facility as a mechanic for vehicle maintenance and general odd jobs around the place. You don't exactly know what they manufacture here. Very secretive need-to-know stuff and the non-disclosure papers seemed pretty clear about not talking about what you see here, otherwise the consequences are severe.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=830722892

[b]Ball Hopper[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-80068100-1484584003_thumb.jpg[/img]
Bounce across platforms to reach the finish, but make sure you get all the checkpoints along the way!
The controls are really simple, but don't think it's going to be easy!
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=831630240

[b]Water Bottle Flip[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-86781900-1484584139_thumb.jpg[/img]
America’s latest craze is now brought to PC! You heard that right – Water Bottle Flip captures the thrill of lobbing perfectly good drinking water in plastic bottles through the air and trying to land it upright on various surfaces. This authentic polymeric encapsulated aquatic simulator realistically captures the exquisite arc of the bottle as it sails effortlessly through the air and onto the target! Throw as many water bottles as you like in the comfort of your own PC gaming chair without having to worry about spilling actual water and soaking your carpets! How many can you land consecutively on the table? Can you trick-shot onto the vending machine? Can you simply just land one before casting yourself out into the void out of frustration? Try it out and see!
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=832449886

[b]Home Sweet Home[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-53940200-1484584194_thumb.jpg[/img]
You wake up to find you are on a deserted Island.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=833689777

[b]Rick Powers[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-25076900-1484584538_thumb.jpg[/img]
After waking in an unknown facility, you find and connect psychically with a future tech orb which allows you to teleport to places you throw it to. Use the sticky ball powerup and the ball sticks to anything. Use the bomb powerup to create an energy blast to break things. Can you escape?
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=833784148

[b]A Long Journey[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-12211400-1484584577_thumb.jpg[/img]
Now whether that's what I've created for a WinterTournament is enough, no clue. But I hope you have fun. So far, there are only two maps. But there will be more. In total there are 10 maps with different scenarios, effects etc.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=837157451

[b]Pig's Adventure Dodgeball[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-69119600-1484584656_thumb.jpg[/img]
This game started out as a typical dodgeball game but then morphed into something a bit different. At any rate, the object of the game is to try to break down all of the boxes on the target platform before you run out of balls.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=837269229

[b]Jimmi the Rabbit[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-77815700-1484584743_thumb.jpg[/img]
Guide Jimmi to his house before time runs out. Collect as many carrots as you con.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=842614008

[b]Spinguins[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-17000700-1484584836_thumb.jpg[/img]
Evil snowmen are planning to invade your planet! Quick, hop into your rocket ship and blast them away! Make sure to steal their hot choco for some Health & Power boost!
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=843127624

[b]Sot Kaal[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-10558500-1484584900_thumb.jpg[/img]
It works, but it's unfinished. Second level isn't there, I'll update soon.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=843269353

[b]Snow Riders[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-19442600-1484585748_thumb.jpg[/img]
Snow Rider is an arcade snowboarding game.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=843483061

[b]Enemy Z[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-82916800-1484585783_thumb.jpg[/img]
Prepare your defense against waves of the undead.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=843731357

[b]WhiteOut[/b]
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cpknmwXsfFQ
Race against your friends and the AI and be the last one standing! Up to 8 racers at a time.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/whiteout-r121

[b]Mass Micron[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-35495600-1484585891_thumb.png[/img]
The game is supposed to be a boss battle within a single room.  The boss will be invulnerable to direct fire but elements in the room will allow you to take him down.  E.g disable missiles, reduce boss reaction time etc.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/mass-micron-r122

[b]Structura[/b]
[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_01_2017/blogentry-1364-0-10246000-1484585975_thumb.png[/img]
Game type real time strategy game.
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/topic/15575-structura-demo-alpha-1/

notes.title: Leadwerks GUI integration
notes.content:
Leadwerks Game Launcher has been updated with the new Leadwerks GUI.  Leadwerks GUI provides a cross-platform user interface that scales to any resolution.  Although Leadwerks Game Launcher is an early release title that is still in development, the introduction of the new GUI improves the look and usability of the program.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9909018/98e5f42964fea1e59bdd58d2c59320535f4ae544.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Leadwerks Summer Games 2016 Roundup
notes.content:
With the Summer Games 2016 Tournament completed, it's time to review the entries.  This tournament brought a new level of quality, with several small games that could be considered Greenlight-ready, made in just four weeks!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wiljzBFNvsM
[b]Sound Game[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=732192584

Test your spatial reasoning skills in this unique and challenging game.  Navigate with your map and lit up clues to get to the end of the maze.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9514[/img]

[b]Soundscape[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=732248859

Solve the mystery in this atmospheric puzzle adventure.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9515[/img]

[b]Astrotrack[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=733382938

Race through this futuristic yet retro world with a rockin' 8-bit soundtrack.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9516[/img]

[b]Log Riders[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=734499057

Jump from log to log in this fun physics-driven game.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9517[/img]

[b]Realm of the Lamb[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=735323135

Explore the afterworld in this atmospheric adventure.  A great example of storytelling and pacing.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9518[/img]

[b]Little Dagon[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=735476592

Run.  Glide.  Shoot fireballs.  Any way you do it, you're going to have a blast in this polished and fun game.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9519[/img]

[b]Leadblocks Jump n' Run[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=743969073

Slafstraf is back, not with horror, but with a psychadelic first-person jumping experience.  Test your skills with this challenging LSD-driven adventure.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9520[/img]

[b]Anesthetic[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=747490351

Blast through hordes of enemies in this frantic fast-paced action title.  Steam Leaderboards let you see how well you're doing compared to other players.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9521[/img]

[b]Spookemon Go![/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=747753330

Race an RC car around your beach house and collect all the Spookemons.   You've got to catch them all!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9522[/img]

[b]Robo Platformer[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=747899296

Jump your robot from platform to platform in this challenging third-person game.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9523[/img]

[b]FPS Nightmare[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=748730998

Fight for your very soul.  We couldn't have said it any better.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9524[/img]

[b]The Hankinator's House of Darkness[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=749141006

A blend of action and puzzle-solving with excellent game mechanics makes this a must-play!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9525[/img]

[b]Dino Land[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/dino-land-r113

Collect photos of dinosaurs in this unique adventure!  Also features completely awesome water.  Did we mention there's dinosaurs?

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9526[/img]

[b]TinyGom[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/tinygom-r110

Race a tiny remote-control car through a fun and active setting.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9527[/img]

[b]Pew Pew Bang Bang[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/pew-pew-bang-bang-r111

Red vs. Blue team-based battles.  What more do you need to know?  Go play it!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9528[/img]

[b]Run!  Jump!  Crawl![/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/run-jump-climb-r114

A classic side-scroller with satisfying graphics and a fun vibe.  Try it out!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9529[/img]

[b]Crawler's Den[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/crawlers-den-r115

Replay the Leadwerks AI and Events map with this reimagined implementation done in pure C++.  There's also an interesting blog about the development experience.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9530[/img]

[b]Grimlight[/b]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/grimlight-r116

Sneak through the corridor and avoid the enemies.  Excellent map design makes this a great entry to check out.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/index.php?app=core&module=attach&section=attach&attach_rel_module=blogentry&attach_id=9531[/img]

notes.title: urWorld Released for Leadwerks Game Launcher
notes.content:

[b]urWorld[/b] is a third-person survival game.  [url=http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=634076765]Play it now[/url].

Banished from your home town, dropped in the middle of the woods left for dead. Use your skill and cunning you attempt to survive the elements; hunt, and keep safe. 

[b]Environment[/b]
The environment can be your best friend or worst enemy. You must use it's resources to help you survive 

[b]Weather[/b]
The weather is constantly changing. Protect yourself from the elements. 

[b]Crafting[/b]
Whether it be a creating a tool, or a log cabin. Items you collect can be mixed together to create something new. 

[b]Tools[/b]
Increase your productivity with tools or make a previously impossible job possible.Once made you will need them to work the land. 

[b]Vitals[/b]
The woods are unforgiving you must make sure you take steps not to freeze, starve or injured. 

[b]Food[/b]
Gathering fruit in the forest or hunting a wild boar, you must find food to survive. 

[b]Darkness:[/b]
Beware the darkness. Terror lurks in the shadow of night.

notes.title: Games of Winter Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The Leadwerks 2016 Winter Games Tournament is complete!  This tournament brought some new types of games we haven't seen before, with a wide range of new games to try.  Here's a review.

[h1]The Adventures of Relic Rick[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/the-adventures-of-relic-rick-public-alpha-v100-r108

You control the adventurer, Rick, who is on a hunt for an ancient artifact for his museum. During his search in an underground ruin, he feels an earthquake and, before he knows it, the ground caves in beneath his feet! Rick is then swallowed into a secret temple! Trapped inside, Rick must proceed forward through the newly discovered ruin using his wits to solve puzzles, collect keys, and survive to escape the labyrinth. Will he ever find a way out of this secret underground dungeon or will it become his permanent tomb? It is up to you to help guide Rick out of his unfortunate state.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-46105100-1456426242_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sentinal Defect[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=625497837

Survive against waves of killer robot spiders, armed with an SMG and an endless supply of ammunition.  How many waves can you survive?  The visual design is simple but consistent and striking.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-78670500-1456423581_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Present Hunt[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=629645154

Gather the presents and bring them to the tree.  Heavy post-processing effects and a rich atmosphere make this an environment worth exploring.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-53745700-1456424516_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dungeon Creeper[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=621811493

You're the pest-control snow-machine repair guy! Your career in life is to visit different places on your trusty boat and fix their machinery.

This winter, you've received a special call out to Snow Town - their snow machine has broken down and they need you to re-set it!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-49026000-1456423958_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]d4Shmup[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630002481

An overhead shoot-em-up made with Leadwerks!  Pilot your ship through a short level blasting enemies in your path.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-53201400-1456424118_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Hankinator's Ode to Alpha Dog[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=626762660

The Hankinator is back with another wacky game.  You are a dog air-dropped into a viking village on a mission to bite as many people as possible.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-93308400-1456424244.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Lost and The Fallen[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630028747

This interesting concept lets you lead your dog to locate a missing person.  Locate the missing individual with the help of your dog. Should be possible to 'complete' the first single level but only intended as very early demo.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-18825900-1456424630_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Science Preview[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=605707281

This science fiction FPS pits you against an endless onslaught of terrifying monsters.  The level design is reminiscent of 1990's shooters.  Try it now!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-70209200-1456424682_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Maze Sweeper[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=630071001

From the author:
You have gotten captured by evil scientist trying to experement on you, when you find guns and a way out, you find a monster that has not became so crazy as the other monsters, and he knows the way through the maze to the teleporter, you hope he will last, but he may become crazy on the way out.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-76644100-1456424954_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Nennerog[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=627877110

An experimental first-person shooter from first-time author lbxr2000.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-87739500-1456425375_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]My Place[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=626851826

Explore the mountain base.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-26471700-1456425431_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]3rd Person Controller[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=616558416

This tech demo lets you control a character in third-person view, with lots of level interactions to try.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-55928300-1456425537_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Ice Island[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=610426359

While not strictly a game, this is an interesting environment to explore.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-54782700-1456425842_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]ZombScar[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=615676471

Explore the surface of another planet.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-60056400-1456425578_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pong3D[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=603368404

Play the classic game "Pong" in a bright flashing futuristic 3D setting.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-31501700-1456425918_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Recovery[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=613979230

A beginning game made with Workshop content, with a cool menu.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_02_2016/blogentry-1364-0-17033400-1456426070_thumb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SteamOS Beta Support
notes.content:
Leadwerks Game Launcher now works with SteamOS, with some caveats.

First, you must set the application to use the "Official Bindings" controller configuration by Leadwerks Software.

When you start Leadwerks Game Launcher on SteamOS, a page of available games will be shown.  Click on the game you want to play.  The game will be shown on a new page, and a blue button will appear on the bottom left of the screen.  You can press the B button on your controller to go back to the main page, or mouse the cursor over the blue button and click (right trigger).

The application will pause while the game is downloaded.  At this time no progress indicator is shown while downloading, but most games only take a few seconds.  The game will then launch.  Most games can be exited by pressing the right arrow button just to the right of the Steam button on your controller. Some games will presently not work correctly.

To exit the game launcher, press the right arrow button just to the right of the Steam button.

notes.title: Halloween Game Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The 2015 Leadwerks Halloween Game Tournament is complete, with results above and beyond any previous game tournament.  The quality, content, and fun of the lineup of games this tournament is really spectacular.

[h1]Halloween Pumpkin Run[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=540259470

If one game summed up the spirit of this year's tournament, it's this title.  The atmosphere, gameplay, and fun of this title make it an instance classic in the Leadwerks catalog of user-made games.

Try to collect all the pumpkins but beware the graveyard residents who don't like trespassers disturbing them. The more pumpkins you take the more dead will awaken!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-29852700-1446944089_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Siege (Download)[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/games/_/siege-r105

SIEGE is an RTS where two teams fight to be the last one standing. Once a combatant has been slain, it will turn into a zombie and fight anyone who is near him. Make sure YOU are the one standing in the end.

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-64888500-1446999046_thumb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Island of Fear[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=534704938

You live in a small house on a fishing island, One day Henry has caught an unknown species successfully. As the people of Island of Fear no longer have big catch more had they had for fish to eat before had. Henry cut off it was over the campfire and test it. notes.title: Halloween Game Tournament Roundup
notes.content:
The 2015 Leadwerks Halloween Game Tournament is complete, with results above and beyond any previous game tournament.  The quality, content, and fun of the lineup of games this tournament is really spectacular.

[h1]Halloween Pumpkin Run[/h1]
http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/page/viewitem?fileid=540259470

If one game summed up the spirit of this year's tournament, it's this title.  The atmosphere, gameplay, and fun of this title make it an instance classic in the Leadwerks catalog of user-made games.

Try to collect all the pumpkins but beware the graveyard residents who don't like trespassers disturbing them. The more pumpkins you take the more dead will awaken!

[img]http://www.leadwerks.com/werkspace/uploads/monthly_11_2015/blogentry-1364-0-29852700-1446944089_thumb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Leadwerks Game Launcher gains 2000 users in first week
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/355500]Leadwerks Game Launcher[/url] was released last week as a free early access title, picking up [b]2000 users[/b] after one week.

Leadwerks Game Launcher connects indie developers with players who want to be involved in the creative process of new games that are early in development.  Steam users can download the application for free and play a variety of creative, experimental, and wacky games and demos.

The application is still in early access mode, with a final release scheduled for later this year.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam Early Access - Leadwerks Game Launcher
notes.content:
Leadwerks Game Launcher is Now Available on Steam Early Access!

Leadwerks Game Launcher lets you play a variety of creative, experimental, and wacky mini-games made with Leadwerks Game Engine. Fly a spaceship through an asteroid field, play a round of golf, or ride a lawn mower while dodging killer cows. It's free and there's a constant supply of new things to try.
